verdict.rationale: The synchronous API documents a `language_detection` object that detects the input language either once or continuously, so callers need not declare the language up front. This is backed by the multilingual model's coverage of ten languages plus 26 Whisper locales. Missing for 10: documentation of the detected-language field in responses, confirmation that detection works in live and batch modes (evidence covers fast mode only), the list of languages detection supports, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
